messages:
Eli Torres: PSA  my Outlook calendar shows two orientation events for Thu (one Zoom, one "Redwood Calendar" copy). which is the single source of truth?
Harper Nguyen: official = Zoom invite from onboarding@redwood.com. some calendar connectors (Outlook <> GCal) created a duplicate. delete the duplicate to avoid double reminders.
Zoe Patel: im in NZDT and my invite time looked off after i imported the .ics manually. any quick sync tips?
Marcus Wu: delete the manually imported event and accept the onboarding calendar invite directly. if that fails, go to Calendar Settings > Time zone and refresh calendar subscription.
Eli Torres: thanks. will the session be recorded for APAC folks?
Onboarding Bot: Recording: yes. Uploaded to onboarding S3 ~30-60 minutes after session ends. Transcript + English captions enabled. Translation requests fulfilled within 48 hours upon request to onboarding@redwood.com. Retention: 90 days for orientation recordings.
Harper Nguyen: updated event subject to explicitly show PT label (we now use PT): "08:30 PT / 20:30 NZDT / 17:30 CET" so it's clearer across time zones.
Zoe Patel: also requested we add a short prereq checklist in the description (VPN, Slack, laptop imaging). can someone paste it there?
Calendar Admin: added checklist and Drive slides link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/onboard-2026-v4. added APAC alternate live replay link and note about not sharing Zoom externally.
Eli Torres: perfect. last bit  for folks who keep the duplicate, will reminders fire twice?
Calendar Admin: yes, duplicates trigger two reminders. please delete duplicates and accept the onboarding calendar to avoid noise. automated reminders: 24h and 15m before.
Zoe Patel: great, re-accepted canonical invite. thanks everyone! :wave:
